My dear [Miss Millington](../persons.html#1000)
This is a very amusing chapter, and I am glad to hear that [Blue Mantle](../persons.html#836)[^1] directed you to the right quarter for the next subject to be entered into heraldry.[^2] It seems to be an inexhaustible fund of curious information. I am overhurried today so pray excuse my blundering

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Henry Murray Lane (1833-1913), Bluemantle Pursuivant at the College of Arms (1849-1864).

[^2]: Her heraldry articles ran in [MP](../others.html#52) from 1853-1857.
